notes: SITE IDENTITY: https://www.made.com/nl/ is no longer a Made.com storefront. Opened in Chrome, it 301-chains to https://www.nextdirect.com/nl/nl/shop/brand-madecom and finally to https://www.nextdirect.com/nl/nl/brands/madecom (title 'MADE | Next Official Site'). Made survives only as a BRAND FILTER FACET (brand:madecom) inside Next Retail's international site. There is no Made category tree, no Furniture department, and no Dutch Made catalogue. ROBOTS: checked made.com/robots.txt and nextdirect.com/robots.txt in-tab; neither names ClaudeBot / anthropic-ai / Claude-Web and neither disallows the site. ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, own tab. CATALOGUE SIZE: 94 products, from the rendered brand header 'VERVAARDIGD (94)' and from the embedded PLP state search.totalResults=94. Independently proved by exhaustion: paginating ?p=1..10 yielded exactly 94 unique structured itemNumber values (p=1..9 x10, p=10 x4, p=11 empty), equal to totalResults. FURNITURE CATEGORY = ABSENT. The brand facet's complete category list is: cushions 23, bedsets 21, dinnerware 8, curtains 7, wallart 5, towels 4, glasses 4, vases 4, bedsheets 3, pillowcases 3, throws 3, bathmats 2, bowls 2, plantpots 1. Only one department exists (homeware 94). DISCRIMINATION CHECK (the brief's false-absence test) PASSED: Next NL's own homeware department (14,359 products) DOES carry furniture categories - sidetable 81, shelves 47, cabinets 24, nestoftables 14, stoolsottomans 10 - so the facet machinery surfaces furniture when furniture is present. Applying those same slugs to the brand returned brands/madecom/f/category-sidetable = 0 and /f/category-cabinets = 0 with the literal page text 'We found no results matching your search.', while the positive control /f/category-vases returned 4. The 0 pages did NOT silently serve the 94-item parent, so the URL shape is trustworthy. FURNITURE PRODUCTS DO EXIST BUT ARE UN-CATEGORISED. A material-lens sweep found the only three items in a furniture-capable material class, and all three are bedside tables: (1) material-wooden = 1 item, itemNumber 407779, 'MADE.COM Nachtkastje van rotan Pavia' (Pavia rattan nightstand), EUR 244; (2) material-painted = 2 items, itemNumbers V66416 and G59100, both 'MADE.COM Roisin Bedside Table'. Both pages were verified authoritatively: the itemNumbers parsed out of the product-summary blocks exactly equal the PLP state's search.items list, so these are genuine grid results and not recommendation-carousel bleed. The Dutch product name 'Nachtkastje' (nightstand) plus the EUR 244 price is what decided Pavia as furniture rather than a decorative object - it is not the site's tag, which is wrong. WHY NO LEAF URL IS RECORDED: Next tags all three tables under a category whose slug collides with 'bedsheets'; opening brands/madecom/f/category-bedsheets returns 3 DIFFERENT products (itemNumbers AT0737, F43852, B71406 - three colourways of 'Cosy gewassen katoenen extra diep hoeslaken', a fitted sheet), so that URL does not isolate the furniture. The only URLs that isolate these three items are material filter pages, which section 3 forbids recording as categories. Rather than invent a URL or sum 1+2 into a parent number (also forbidden), the single furniture row is emitted with qty null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag carrying the exact per-URL counts the site itself reported. RESIDUAL GAP: the tagged category counts sum to 90 of 94. Because two distinct Dutch category labels ('Beddenlakens' for the sheets, 'Bedlakens' for the tables) collapse onto the same 'bedsheets' facet slug, the true tagged total is probably 93, leaving 1-4 products whose identity was not established. Those were not individually opened. EXCLUDED per section 1: all bedding ('Bed Set', duvet covers, fitted sheets, pillowcases), cushions, throws, curtains, towels, bath mats, wall art, vases, plant pots, dinnerware, glasses and bowls. A keyword scan flagged the 'Bed Set' titles as candidates and they were rejected on product type - they are bedding, not beds. RATE LIMIT: Akamai returned 403 / 'Access Denied' on the /brands/ PLP route after roughly 25 rapid same-origin fetches; the homepage stayed reachable throughout and PLP access recovered after multi-minute gaps. Full-catalogue title enumeration was abandoned for this reason; the material lens above is what closed the furniture question instead.

The site's own category tag for all three collides with the 'bedsheets' slug, and brands/madecom/f/category-bedsheets serves 3 unrelated fitted sheets instead, so no valid listing URL isolates them. Human decision needed on whether to record qty 3 with no link.
